ObjectName.value: Chinese C18: Paediatric pox -- outcome by physiognomic signs

Categories.value: Files with no machine-readable author|Physiognomy|Images uploaded by Fæ|Artworks without Wikidata item|Files from Wellcome Images|Woodcut illustrations in the Wellcome Collection|Chinese C18; Paed. pox - 'Swollen flesh, non-swollen lesions

ImageDescription.value:
Chart indicating favourable or unfavourable outcome of pox diseases according to the physiognomic connotations of the distribution of eruptions on the face. FromYizong jinjian:Douzhen xinfa yaojue(The Golden Mirror Of Medicine: Essential Knowledge and Secrets of Pox Diseases).A medical anthology in 90juan(volumes/fascicles),Yizong jinjianwas executed as an imperial commission by Wu Qian (Qing period, 1644-1911) et al., and printed in Beijing at Wuyingdian (the Hall of Martial Prowess - the imperial printing house) in 1742 (7th year of the Qianlong reign period of the Qing dynasty).Douzhen xinfa yaojue(The Golden Mirror Of Medicine: Essential Knowledge and Secrets of Pox Diseases) is one of 15 monographs included in it. This text deals with the diagnosis and treatment of paediatric pox (er douzhen) (or small pox,tianhua). It runs to fourjuanand is divided into three sections: 'Essential knowledge and secrets' ; 'Appearance and treatment of pox'; 'Various symptoms of pox diseases'.

ImageDescription.value:
Artistically designed front door “Rua de Santa Maria 1” (Joana Henriques, The arT of oPEn doORs), Funchal, Madeira, Portugal
The project “artE das pORtas Abertas” in Rua de Santa Maria and its side streets in Funchal is an art project by various artists that aims to open doors to art and culture. These art interventions take into account all visual arts, from painting and photography to writing.
The project was initiated by artist José Maria Montero Zyberchema and former Regional Secretary for Tourism and Culture João Carlos Abreu. The first door to undergo an intervention was number 207 on Rua de Carreira in Funchal by Martinho Mendes on August 20, 2010. The first door in Rua Santa Maria was painted on April 6, 2011, by artist Mark Milewski at number 77, which took him more than a month to complete. However, the first artistic intervention was started and completed by Gonçalo Martins in Rua Santa Maria nos. 81 to 83 on April 9, 2011.

Artist.value: Dietmar Rabich

ImageDescription.value:
Dune landscape with signpost to the wreck at the eastern end in the Lower Saxon Wadden Sea National Park (quiet zone), Norderney, Lower Saxony, Germany
The Lower Saxon Wadden Sea National Park was established in 1986 and encompasses the East Frisian Islands, mudflats, and sea marshes between Dollart on the border with the Netherlands in the west and Cuxhaven to the Outer Elbe shipping channel in the east. The Lower Saxon Wadden Sea National Park, together with the Schleswig-Holstein Wadden Sea National Park, the Hamburg Wadden Sea National Park, the Danish Vadehavet National Park, and the Dutch Wadden Sea, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In addition, the national park was recognized as a biosphere reserve in 1992 under the UNESCO “Man and Biosphere” program, has been a registered Fauna-Flora Habitat area under the European FFH Directive since 1997 with zones I and II, and has also been a registered bird sanctuary under the European Birds Directive since 2000. The national park is therefore part of the Natura 2000 network and protection regime.
